{"type":"reasoning","timestamp":1794672779067,"sessionID":"ses_e252f0e4cffeFqBvTVHaooTkd0","part":{"id":"prt_1dad53208001Ut2ZWefHUrw1Uz","messageID":"msg_1dad529a7001xJv7xQOSZ6Ytqs","sessionID":"ses_e252f0e4cffeFqBvTVHaooTkd0","type":"reasoning","text":"**Analyzing Month 7**\n\nI'm incredibly excited about what Month 7 reveals. Supply for Month 6 shipped 4.78k, as originally planned! The contract index dipped slightly, a mere -0.8% change, so there are not major concerns here yet. I'm moving toward further analysis, so I can see what is happening in the coming months.\n\n\n**Assessing Month 7 Dynamics**\n\nI've made some significant discoveries! The supply index calculates to 0.955, and the news suggests HBM supply is loosening with a third vendor's qualification, making the Month 7 supply regime approximately 98% loose! I'm also refining the Gen N launch expectation to be centered around a mean of 17. Looking at the current application (ap) and queue, I see that 0.93k H is delivered, and 6k more becomes eligible next month, with capacity increasing as well.\n\n\n**Projecting Future Availability**\n\nI'm now diving into Months 8 through 15 and 16 through 23! Month 8 marks the beginning of the 8..15 window, a critical period for inference growth. Currently, we have 33k H in the pipeline plus 2k H reserves. With a projected 268 kH-months available in Months 8..15, we have a surplus of 48-60 kH-months, guaranteeing 8..15 is LOCKED IN! Now, I'm analyzing Months 16..23, anticipating the needs there.\n\n\n**Calculating Future Requirements**\n\nI've determined a potential gap of 142 to 201 kH-months in Months 16-23. Gen N is scheduled to launch in Months 16-18, making it usable in Months 19-21. Also, buying Gen H is not needed since we have a surplus in Months 8-15. This leaves us focused on Months 16-23. Notably, Gen H would cost $2.76M/kH-month if bought now!\n\n\n**Evaluating Cost Efficiencies**\n\nI've determined that purchasing additional Gen H is not economical. Buying more Gen H now provides utility only for Months 16-23, costing a hefty $2.76M per kH-month. The options present more affordable alternatives at $1.767M/kH-month, and post-launch cloud costs could decrease to $1.5..1.9M/kH-month. My calculations also show Gen N on existing power offers a more attractive rate at $1.39-$1.74M/kH-month. Therefore, no further Gen H purchases are warranted. I will continue to review the 'us' and the project details.\n\n\n**Determining Power Renewal Costs**\n\nI'm now calculating the costs associated with power renewal. At US, renewing 10 MW for Months 20-23 totals $36M, which equates to $1.26M/kH-month if used to run existing H. Similarly, renewing 6 MW in EU costs $28.8M, or $1.68M/kH-month. I am investigating whether to renew existing power, replace with N, or let H sit.\n\n\n","time":{"start":1794672767496,"end":1794672779061}}}
